text:
alex: FYI opened a docs PR that updates the migration guide and a python SDK snippet. preview build errored with a missing asset (../assets/logo.svg). PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/489

nina: thanks. do examples currently fall under CODEOWNERS? i thought it only matched /docs/**. if not we should add /examples/** -> @redwood/docs so reviews auto-assign.

ci-bot: build: docs-preview FAILED
Summary: 1 error - GET ../assets/logo.svg returned 404 while rendering docs/migration-guide/index.md

alice: can we also make a safe auto-merge flow for docs-only PRs? small link fixes and example tweaks shouldn't need manual clicks. idea: label `docs/auto-ready` + GH action that validates checks + quick safety scan.

matt: agree in principle but we need rules: must be docs-only (no src/ changes), required checks green (docs-preview, md-lint, spellcheck), not during release freeze. Also exclude examples/private/** and any changed files matching '*.env' or '*secret*'.

nina: proposed CODEOWNERS change (snippet):

```
# Docs team for content and examples
/docs/ @redwood/docs
/examples/** @redwood/docs
```

alex: that solves reviewer assignment. for auto-merge the GH action could run a short script to confirm changed paths. sample pseudo-step:

```
- name: Blocklist scan
  run: |
    git fetch origin ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.ref }}
    changed=$(git diff --name-only origin/${{ github.event.pull_request.base.ref }} ${{ github.sha }})
    echo "$changed" | grep -E "(^examples/private/|\.env$|secret)" && exit 1 || exit 0
```

alice: and an additional check for repo-wide CODEOWNERS changes: if PR modifies CODEOWNERS, require admin approval and skip auto-merge.

matt: for freeze windows i can add a small calendar-based check in the workflow or call our release-bot to post a comment and add label `hold` automatically. prefer not to merge if freeze active.

alice: merge method: squash preferred for docs. also the workflow should post a comment when it auto-merges (who did it + commit sha) for audit.

ci-bot: note: Changing CODEOWNERS will trigger review requests and may block auto-merge until approvals are satisfied.

alex: i'll remove the missing asset reference in my PR (inline the logo for preview) and re-run. i'll wait for the CODEOWNERS PR to land before labeling `docs/auto-ready`.
nina: opened a CODEOWNERS PR to add examples: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/490

matt: once CODEOWNERS merges i can approve the automation workflow. one more ask: the workflow should require the label and a human to add it (no bot-labeling allowed) to ensure someone reviewed the content.
alice: agreed. human gate + label + checks + path-safety scan + freeze check = safe.

alex: thanks all. quick action items: nina follow up on CODEOWNERS PR, matt wire up freeze/hold rule, alice draft the auto-merge workflow and include the blocklist scan, i'll fix the asset and add label once CODEOWNERS is merged.

(Action summary: nina -> CODEOWNERS PR, alice -> draft workflow, matt -> freeze rule, alex -> fix preview asset and request label)
